rationale.A: 200 m in traffic on Pohjolankatu (tram) plus Helsinginkatu; then path beside Ratapihantie and Linnunlaulu; 5 lights
rationale.B: No mixed traffic: quiet Käpylä streets, then paths beside Koskelantie/Ratapihantie; 3 lights
rationale.C: Same as B, slightly different start; 2 lights
rationale.D: No traffic; Pasila then Töölönlahti/Oopperankuja and Baana; unsignalised Veturitie and Mäntymäentie; 5 lights
rationale.E: Long car-free path from Käpylä via Linnunlaulu; only ~1.3 km beside roads; 1 light; +3 min
rationale.F: Long paths beside Mäkelänkatu (50 km/h), unsignalised Mäkelänkatu/Koskelantie crossings; 13 lights
rationale.G: No traffic, but paths beside Mäkelänkatu, walking sections and three unsignalised arterial crossings
rationale.H: Kumpula and Vallila valley park paths, Linnunlaulu; barely any roadside riding; 2 lights; +6 min

notes: E saves 4 lights for about 3 min and removes A's tram-street stretch. H is a little calmer but costs 3 more minutes for a small gain.
